description: Decomposes Delta^2 g into positive- and negative-weight contributions to quantify the mu3 door budget. Establishes scope-(b) that the 're-weight the Wedderburn weights' escape does not exist (tr_M unique => y_lambda fixed), and scope-(a) that at this operator's character scale the negative-weight blocks fall short of the door by a large factor even at a crude 4*max|chi| ceiling.
caveats: SCOPE: the weights-are-fixed statement is scope-(b) with the invariant named (uniqueness of the non-degenerate Markov trace, prop:markov-trace-frobenius-selection + Alexander-Markov). The CEILING is scope-(a) only: max|chi| is measured on this word, |chi| grows with braid length, and no universal bound is claimed. The ceiling must NOT be quoted as excluding the route for all operators.

Corrects #4657: that PR stated the mixed-sign escape was 'not foreclosed' because reweight_cannot_open_door assumes w >= 0 while the physical y_lambda is sign-indefinite. The hypothesis mismatch was real but the conclusion was wrong -- there is no re-weighting freedom to foreclose in the first place.
